name: Mobile Timer for Clockify
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A note project from its property loads the project list when needed.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Reports (Pro) now use all 2,000 entries that they read, so totals of a busy range are no longer too low.
A clockify-project property (Pro) now works before the project list has loaded.
tip: Put the cursor on a task line and run 'Start timer for this task' to time it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Mobile Timer for Clockify is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to track your time.
